shared_training.recall_threshold: highest development score threshold achieving at least 90% recall
shared_training.f1_threshold: development threshold maximizing F1; ties choose the higher threshold
shared_training.test_policy: apply the selected model, normalization, and thresholds unchanged
shared_training.rgb_pair_reduction: cosine similarity of the two 512-dimensional embeddings

D_pose_aligned_geometry.name: RGB + 2D + oracle-pose-aligned visible-surface geometry
D_pose_aligned_geometry.pose_treatment: use the provided camera-to-world pose only to transform visible-surface geometry

G_pose_aligned_geometry_only.name: Pose-aligned geometry only
G_pose_aligned_geometry_only.pose_treatment: use the provided camera-to-world pose only to transform visible-surface geometry

P_pose_only.name: Pose only
P_pose_only.pose_treatment: use relative camera translation and rotation but no RGB, 2D object, depth, or object-geometry feature

S_shuffled_pose.name: Shuffled pose
S_shuffled_pose.pose_treatment: replace each frame pose with its deterministic within-dataset-and-split deranged pose before geometry transformation
S_shuffled_pose.fit_policy: construct shuffled train/dev/test features and fit an independent model on shuffled training features

N_noisy_pose.name: Noisy pose
N_noisy_pose.pose_treatment: perturb each frame pose once per noise condition before geometry transformation and reuse it for every pair containing that frame
N_noisy_pose.fit_policy: apply the clean fitted D model and D standardization unchanged; do not refit for noise conditions

shuffled_pose.scope: independently within each dataset and locked split over unique eligible frame keys
shuffled_pose.algorithm: sort frame keys by SHA-256(seed|dataset|split|video_id|frame_index), then cyclically shift the associated poses by one
shuffled_pose.fixed_point_policy: no frame retains its own pose when at least two frame keys exist
shuffled_pose.pair_reuse: the assigned pose is held fixed for all observations and pairs from that frame
shuffled_pose.movi_d_note: shuffling identical fixed-camera poses is expected to be structurally equivalent to clean D geometry

noisy_pose.seed_scope: independent deterministic substream per dataset, split, frame key, translation level, and rotation level
noisy_pose.translation_distribution: independent zero-mean Gaussian noise with the declared standard deviation on each world-coordinate x/y/z camera-position component
noisy_pose.rotation_distribution: zero-mean Gaussian axis-angle magnitude with the declared standard deviation and an independently sampled uniform unit axis
noisy_pose.rotation_composition: post-multiply the clean camera-to-world rotation by the sampled camera-local perturbation
noisy_pose.zero_condition: translation=0 and rotation=0 must be byte-equivalent to clean D features
noisy_pose.pair_reuse: a perturbed frame pose is held fixed for every observation and pair containing that frame

transfer.name: D-to-E transfer
transfer.source: MOVi-D clean system D training model, training standardization, selected C, and development thresholds
transfer.target: MOVi-E clean system D feature matrix
